rules: Primary desktop surface is chat plus tools, not a dashboard of cards.
No redundant panel-name bar when a tab already identifies the tool.
Rail 44px; controls 32px; split handles have pointer capture and keyboard semantics.
Switching visible panels never cancels background execution.
Use inline cell editing, preserve NULL versus empty string and zero.
Commit/CAS and actual execution belong to host; keep failed edit and previous result.
Page/stream at source; never read an entire import or result into model context.
Only one meaningful query toolbar; connection/schema next to Execute.
File explorer exists inside IDE only, starts left and can be hidden.
Git state is text plus semantic color, no vendor icons copied.
CodeBlock is a preview/token renderer; full editor comes from IDE engine.
Project tree defaults compact 27px rows with 14px indent.
Stable settings categories and persistent footer actions.
Validation remains beside its control; never clears user input after failure.
Credentials are vault references, not copied into labels, examples or prompts.
Connection IDs global, project bindings reference them; display names/environments editable.
Never hard-code DEV/IFT as the only environments.
Addresses/credentials/tests configured explicitly; share connection references, not secret copies.
Branch left; automatic role before model on right; model and reasoning share one selector.
Context ring wraps Send, changes semantic level, no inline percentage; hover gives exact known values.
At narrow tool-panel widths hide optional branch before squeezing model/reasoning.
Host capabilities determine real reasoning options; vision bridge does not advertise direct vision.
Send now is always visible per queued row, not hidden behind a menu.
Edit uses expectedText CAS; failure retains local draft and host winner.
Send now calls host once; never silently duplicates/replays unknown turn outcome.
Busy queue actions are held; draft edit dialog never implies successful durable save.
One question at a time; choices and custom answer; answers retained by host.
Native modal containment; close and Escape follow controlled caller policy.
Submission error keeps answers; no auto-advance based on guessed intent.
Completed step struck through and less prominent; current step highlighted with optional spinner.
Text status remains meaningful when remote desktop suppresses animation.
Tool calls collapsed into compact activity; errors and unknown results remain discoverable.
Plan is host state with stable IDs and revision, never fabricated progress.
Close crosses actually close their owning tab; dirty close policy belongs to host.
Frequent actions remain visible; secondary actions go in labeled keyboard menu.
Tooltips explain icon-only controls; icon geometry is distinct for meaning.
Never show loading forever without elapsed/time/error/retry context supplied by host.
No automatic success toast without observed result.
Retain previous data with stale indication; show retry only when host says safe.
Actual target, source diff and verification facts precede apply.
Do not confuse visual sign-off with permission to mutate production.
Use specific failure/unknown receipts and evidence rather than decorative pass marks.
Columns have stable IDs; labels and workflow come from host.
Mouse drag and keyboard Move menu invoke the same host command.
Failed or stale move retains original task; no optimistic success.
Bound cards/column and use server filters/paging for large backlogs.
Prefer ready compositions over reconstructing free-form page layout.
Supply actual host state and callbacks; examples are not backend capabilities.
